description:
One result of a long or packaging run with every field: the video, its numbers and
    the opening or the package analysis. find_id comes from a run's finds (get_run) or from
    list_kept_finds. Same shape as GET /v1/finds/{find_id}. Free. Errors: 404
    find_not_found, 422 for an id that is not a UUID.
name: get_find
